Chapter 246 What Happened

But when he said this, the next moment, Jordanyang took out his own special alchemy furnace.

After a while, the smoke from the cooking stove slowly floated out of the courtyard.

And in the city lord's mansion.

"Master Lord, why do you want me to compete with such a little devil for the trial pill?"

Little devil.

This is what Shi Liantian calls Jordan Yang.

In his eyes, Jordanyang, who is at the peak of the alchemy in the fairyland, is just a little devil.

Looking at the disdain in Shi Liantian's eyes, Lu Daosheng was immediately amazed and crying.

If you do this yourself, you will be really wronged and kill the Liantian.

"You are really confident. That guy is still the top alchemist in the Immortal Realm. In your eyes, it's so unbearable?"

Hearing Lu Daosheng a little disbelief.

Shi Liantian shook his head slightly, "Top Alchemist? Haha, he's just a frog in the well."

"When I was refining the alchemy, he probably wasn't born yet."

The tone was full of contempt and disdain.

It is hard to believe how amazing he was in the era when Shi Liantian was in!

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng couldn't say anything else, and just said, "Then you just think it's for me and for the deserted city, and fight this first battle."

In response to this, Shi Liantian sighed in his heart, then nodded and agreed.

In this way, the news of the Huangcheng alchemist competing with Jordan Yang, the powerful alchemy in the Immortal Realm, swept out from the entire Wood Fairy World like a storm.

In the end, for some reason, it was directly transmitted to the Immortal Realm.

For a moment, the entire fairyland was shocked.

"Master Qiao went to the Wood Fairy World to compete? What a century of joke?!"

"Where did the fake news come from? It's so wild?"

"But, Master Qiao really doesn't seem to be in the academy."

Most of the people in the Immortal Realm don’t believe this news.

That is a master who stands at the top of the alchemy world in the fairyland. How could he go to such a remote place and compete with the alchemists there?

What kind of garbage alchemist is worthy of competing with Master Qiao?

However, he said he didn't believe it, but there were still many people rushing towards the direction of the Wood Fairy World.

Inside the Tiandi Academy.

"Urgent report! Urgent report! Teacher Qiao is going to compete with the alchemist there in the Wood Fairy Realm, just three days later!"

The news spread from the academy and caused an uproar.

"Damn it, it's true!"

"Teacher Qiao? Is it the Temper Qiao of Liandan Peak?"

"Nonsense, is there a second mentor Qiao in the entire academy?"

Zhuyun Peak.

A figure ran in panic.

"Brother Xiao! Sister Lu! Major news, major news!"

Hearing the movement, Lu Xue and the others also walked over.

Looking at Qin Feng, who was excited and still gasping for breath, Xiao Luo said with a puzzled look: "Brother Qin, what are you doing? What important news?"

Qin Feng bent down and waved his hand, then slowly stood up and said, "Teacher Qiao, hasn't Tutor Qiao gone to the Wood Fairy Realm?"

"Now there is news that he is going to compete with an alchemist there, and many people have rushed over to watch it."

Upon hearing this, Xiao Luo was immediately surprised.

"Muxian Realm?!"

Suddenly, Xiao Luo thought of something and quickly turned his head to look at Lu Xue.

"Is the Wood Fairy Realm in the Desert City?"

Lu Xue asked.

"Wild City, yes! It's Wild City!"

"Oh? Sister Lu, how do you know?"

After reacting, Qin Feng looked puzzled. He knew the news faster than him.

Lu Xue looked clear.

But, who should I compete with?

In Lu Xue's impression, there seems to be no alchemist in Huangcheng, so it's not that his father will take the battle himself.

Based on her understanding of her father, Lu Daosheng basically doesn't do anything by himself except doing things himself, and usually finds someone to do it directly.

As for how to find it,

Either seduce or threaten violence.

Could it be that where did my father get an alchemist?

Just as Lu Xue pondered, Qin Feng hesitated and said, "You two, are you going to see it?"

Go and have a look?

Lu Xue was slightly stunned, while Xiao Luo was very interested.

"Lu Xue, that,"

"You want to go?"

Lu Xue asked.

Xiao Luo smiled awkwardly and nodded slightly.

Seeing this, Lu Xue sighed and then go and have a look.

I also thought it was going home to take a look.

At this time, the alchemy meeting was still being held as scheduled. After all, a month has just passed halfway through now.

"Senior Sister Bai, Senior Sister Bai!"

At this time, at the alchemy meeting, a disciple of the alchemy peak suddenly ran in panic.

Break the tranquility in the alchemy meeting.

For a moment, everyone looked at the yelling person.

Only eight alchemists were left looking at the alchemy furnace in front of them solemnly, not daring to relax at all.

To refine alchemy, you must concentrate on it. If something goes wrong, the pill will be invalid.

Seriously, the entire alchemy furnace will explode.

"Junior brother, what are you doing! This is an alchemy training!"

Another disciple of the Alchemy Peak stood up, stopped the disciple, and immediately scolded in a low voice.

The disciple took a breath and was about to speak.

The next moment.

boom!

An explosion sounded.

The entire alchemy will be shocked immediately.

Everyone turned their heads and saw that one of the young alchemists who were still practicing alchemy seriously just now were covered in dust, with a confused look on their faces, staring blankly in front of them.

The alchemy furnace in front of him had already been fried to pieces, leaving only some residual soup left in place.

"ah!!!"

A heart-wrenching roar rang out.

The alchemist immediately looked at the disciple of the Alchem Peak who was still yelling just now, with an extremely fierce look in his eyes.

"It's all your fault! You pay me a pill refining furnace!!"

The young alchemist roared and rushed directly towards the disciple.

In the blink of an eye, the wailing sounded from the disciple's mouth.

"Ao!!"

"Senior brother, please calm down!!"

The two of them were very moved.

In addition, he was an alchemist, and his status was obviously not low. No one present dared to come forward to stop him, and all stood aside to watch the show.

Just a moment later, the remaining alchemists had problems one after another.

Several more muffled sounds rang out.

The alchemy of several alchemists also failed.

However, their luck was obviously better, and the alchemy furnace was not directly blown up.

But the alchemy was interrupted, no matter who has a good temper, he can't stand it.

Suddenly, several alchemists looked at the source with anger.

"What are you doing!"

Buzz —

As the alchemy furnace in front of Bai Lushuang trembled slightly, all the alchemists present declared failure.

Looking at the alchemy furnace in front of him, Bai Lushuang was silent for a long time, slowly opened the alchemy furnace, and found a pretty intact young pill from it.

Strictly speaking, she did not fail, but the last step was not completed yet.

She ended it early.

"What the hell happened?"

Bai Lushuang's expression changed and she spoke coldly.
